fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2025-08-25 (morning, 10:50): The owner of Kurinji Stationery reported repeated demands for weekly payments of Rs. 4,500 from persons visiting the premises near Nila Park Industrial Area. The complainant, Arjun Karuppasamy, provided the contact number 9000000172. The complainant is associated with the business Kurinji Stationery. A yellow car with registration TN-58-XX-1084 was observed near Nila Park Industrial Area. Padmini Sri (9000000119) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. The complainant mentioned the account SYN-ACC-100080 as the destination of the transfer. A person named Ezhilan Ramasamy, associated with the number 9000000042, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. The complainant mentioned a call detail reference. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00146, as the mobile number 9000000042 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Payment demands reportedly made with veiled threats. A car was reportedly used to leave the area.
fields.Keywords: extortion, business, call detail, mobile number, witness, industrial area, receiving account, suspect
